div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Known fact explains the expected delta?
code tests scope + valid dates, never the model

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
intent: function=ar · question · owner
e.g. Resolve the $1,200 shortfall on INV-1042
end_condition_json: balance 0 or hold set

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent router
tier 0 compiled policy or fact, no model call
tier 1 claude-haiku-4-5 → tier 2 claude-sonnet-5
→ tier 3 claude-opus-5

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalise, keep raw
integer cents · value_date and posted_date stored
fold whitespace / case / encoding
raw descriptor kept in trace.payload_json

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stable key lookup
originator_company_id · ISO 20022 EndToEndId
/ AcctSvcrRef → customer.id

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alias table: fact predicate=alias
normalised payer string → customer.id
source cited: prior payment trace,
contract signature block, CRM domain

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Parent / child link
customer.parent_id + fact pays_for
parent pays for subsidiary:
child invoices join the candidate set

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Resolved to exactly one customer.id?

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stable party key = customer.id + hierarchy set
descriptor text is evidence only,
never a rule predicate (A-09, G-09)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Blocking: candidate generation
open invoices of party + hierarchy only
invoice date lte bank value_date

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 1 · Remittance join (directed)
advice linked by payer + amount + date window
-5 / +3 days (DESIGN)
advice exists: apply AS DIRECTED, no search

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Advice re-footed in code
sum(lines) equals stated total
equals bank amount?

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 2 · Exact 1:1
amount equals open balance AND normalised
invoice number found in addenda / reference

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 3 · Near-reference 1:1 (A-12)
amount + party exact · invoice number at
Damerau-Levenshtein distance 1 (10423 vs 10432)
unique: PROPOSE with the transposition named

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 4a · Typed delta: known fact
expected = balance x (1 - pct_off), fact in scope
Initech: 12,000 x 0.90 = 10,800

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 4b · Typed delta: contractual early-pay discount
(contract terms, paid inside the window), then
Pass 4c · wire-fee band: policy per bank / corridor,
clamped (G-08), 1:1 only (A-03 shape: 17.50)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 4d · else unclassified short-pay
1:1 on party + reference, delta unexplained
goes to residual classification

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Subset-sum bound: n lte 24 open items?
above n: do not search,
ESCALATE with the candidate list

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 5 · Bounded subset-sum (A-05, C-05)
exact integer cents, NO tolerance
meet-in-the-middle O(2^(n/2)) or DP
stops after 2 solutions

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Uniqueness gate (A-18, C-05)
every pass returns ALL candidates up to 2
a second candidate: refuse to pick,
ESCALATE and show all

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Match result and residual type (code)
applications: doc_id + amount_cents
residual_cents = bank amount - sum(applications)
zero · short · over

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Short-pay reason gate (code) on port C output
must be: quoted span + predicate it supports
(pct_off, until) OR not found + every place searched
quote re-checked as a substring of its trace

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unapplied cash
on the customer, or suspense if payer unknown
never forced onto an invoice
open at month end → close checklist_item

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Returned ACH / NSF / originator reversal (A-15)
pair by trace number / original ref, NOT amount
reverse the application, reopen the invoice
ACH receipts provisional 5 banking days (DESIGN)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Overpayment (A-21)
apply 10,000 · 2,000 → kind=customer_credit
a liability line, never revenue

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Remittance disagrees with cash (C-06)

apply per advice, the 820 becomes
its own short-pay case

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

EXAMPLE Wayne: pays $3,300 short
contract, CRM, mail, Slack searched:
nothing explains it → does not guess
→ ESCALATE to the owner in Slack

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Short-pay, reason not derivable (A-20)
apply partial · kind=dispute_hold
question to the account owner

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Short-pay claiming an unissued credit (C-08)
open a deduction case · dispute_hold
never written off silently

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

+ fact pct_off=10 until renewal

kind=credit_memo + terms_change
